text: RTL + bidi support so Arabic ships in the first wave

Done in 760610b. Correction to this ticket's own body: it claimed every user-content site needs bidi isolation. That is wrong for Android — Compose already resolves an unspecified TextDirection from the content's first strong character, so plain Text(userValue) is correct as-is. The real exposure is only user text embedded INSIDE a sentence, which is a much smaller surface. Also: two of the three prerequisites were already in place from T-111 (web <html dir>, LocalLayoutDirection, and android:supportsRtl was already true in the manifest), so only layout + bidi remained. The AdminPage toggle needed its CSS transition renamed alongside its position property, not just the position — otherwise the knob jumps instead of sliding. Isolation is conditional on the value actually containing RTL characters, so all-LTR output is byte-identical.
